ayahs.textUthmani: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: الٓر‌ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: ال࢜رٰࣞ تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ الْكِتٰبِ وَقُرْاٰنٍ مُّبِيْنٍ
ayahs.translation: Alif, Lām, Rā.[668] These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
ayahs.translationClear: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the Verses of the Book; a Quran that makes things clear.

ayahs.textUthmani: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: رُبَمَا يَوَدُّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَوْ كَانُوْا مُسْلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish[669] that they had been Muslims.
ayahs.transliteration: Rubamaa yawaddul-ladheena kafaroo law kaanoo muslimeen

footnotes.669: On the Day of Judgement or at the time of death.

ayahs.translationClear: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish they had been Muslims.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ‌ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: ذَرْهُمْ يَاْكُلُوْا وَيَتَمَتَّعُوْا وَيُلْهِهِمُ الْاَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
ayahs.transliteration: Dharhum ya'kuloo wayatamatta'oo wayulhihimul-amalu fasawfa ya'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: Leave them to eat, and enjoy, and be lulled by hope. They will find out.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَرْيَةٍ اِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُوْمٌ
ayahs.translation: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa ahlaknaa min qaryatin illaa walahaa kitaabum ma'loom
ayahs.translationClear: We have never destroyed a town unless it had a set time.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ اُمَّةٍ اَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَاْخِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
ayahs.transliteration: Maa tasbiqu min ummatin ajalahaa wamaa yasta'khiroon
ayahs.translationClear: No nation can bring its time forward, nor can they delay it.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُوْا يٰٓاَيُّهَا الَّذِيْ نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ الذِّكْرُ اِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُوْنٌ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.[670]
ayahs.translationClear: And they said, “O you who received the message, you are insane.”

ayahs.textUthmani: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: لَوْ مَا تَاْتِيْنَا بِالْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةِ اِنْ كُنْتَ مِنَ الصّٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"
ayahs.transliteration: Law maa ta'teenaa bil-malaa'ikati in kunta minas-saadiqeen
ayahs.translationClear: “Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are truthful?”

ayahs.textUthmani: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: مَا نُنَزِّلُ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةَ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوْٓا اِذًا مُّنْظَرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: We do not send down the angels except with truth;[671] and they [i.e., the disbelievers] would not then be reprieved.
ayahs.transliteration: Maa nunazzilul-malaa'ikata illaa bil-haqqi wamaa kaanoo idham munzareen

footnotes.671: i.e., with a message or, as the conclusion of the verse suggests, to carry out a promised punishment.

ayahs.translationClear: We do not send the angels down except with reason, and they will not be held back.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا الذِّكْرَ وَاِنَّا لَهٗ لَحٰفِظُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, it is We who sent down the message [i.e., the Qur’ān], and indeed, We will be its guardian.
ayahs.transliteration: Innaa nahnu nazzalnadh-dhikra wa'innaa lahoo lahaafizoon
ayahs.translationClear: Surely We revealed the Message, and We will surely preserve it.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ فِيْ شِيَعِ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muḥammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad arsalnaa min qablika fee shiya'il-awwaleen
ayahs.translationClear: We sent others before you, to the former communities.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا يَاْتِيْهِمْ مِّنْ رَّسُوْلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa ya'teehim mir rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi'oon
ayahs.translationClear: But no messenger came to them, but they ridiculed him.

ayahs.textUthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: كَذٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهٗ فِيْ قُلُوْبِ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Thus do We insert it [i.e., denial] into the hearts of the criminals.
ayahs.translationClear: Thus We slip it into the hearts of the guilty.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ‌ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ بِهٖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ الْاَوَّلِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yu'minoona bihee waqad khalat sunnatul-awwaleen
ayahs.translationClear: They do not believe in it, though the ways of the ancients have passed away.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَابًا مِّنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ فَظَلُّوْا فِيْهِ يَعْرُجُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
ayahs.transliteration: Walaw fatahnaa 'alayhim baabam minas-samaa'i fazalloo feehi ya'rujoon
ayahs.translationClear: Even if We opened for them a gateway into the sky, and they began to ascend through it.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: لَقَالُوْٓا اِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ اَبْصَارُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُوْرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."
ayahs.transliteration: Laqaaloo innamaa sukkirat absaarunaa bal nahnu qawmum mas'hooroon
ayahs.translationClear: They would still say, “Our eyes are hallucinating; in fact, we are people bewitched.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي السَّمَا࢜ءِ بُرُوْجًا وَّزَيَّنّٰهَا لِلنّٰظِرِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad ja'alnaa fis-samaa'i buroojan wazayyannaahaa linnaazireen
ayahs.translationClear: We placed constellations in the sky, and made them beautiful to the beholders.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَحَفِظْنَـٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَحَفِظْنَـٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَحَفِظْنٰهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطٰنٍ رَّجِيْمٍ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allāh]
ayahs.translationClear: And We guarded them from every outcast devil.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا مَنِ اسْتَرَقَ السَّمْعَ فَاَتْبَعَهٗ شِهَابٌ مُّبِيْنٌ
ayahs.translation: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
ayahs.translationClear: Except one who steals a hearing, and is followed by a visible projectile.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالْاَرْضَ مَدَدْنٰهَا وَاَلْقَيْنَا فِيْهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَاَنۢ͏ْبَتْنَا فِيْهَا مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَّوْزُوْنٍ
ayahs.translation: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-arda madadnaahaa wa'alqaynaa feehaa rawaasiya wa'ambatnaa feehaa min kulli shay'im mawzoon
ayahs.translationClear: We spread the earth, and placed stabilizers in it, and in it We grew all things in proper measure.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيْهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَنْ لَّسْتُمْ لَهٗ بِرٰزِقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.[672]
ayahs.transliteration: Waja'alnaa lakum feehaa ma'aayisha wamal lastum lahoo biraaziqeen

footnotes.672: Allāh has put at your service other men and animals for which He provides. An additional meaning is that Allāh provides means for your living and for all other creatures as well.

ayahs.translationClear: And in it We created livelihoods for you, and for those for whom you are not the providers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنْ مِّنْ شَيْءٍ اِلَّا عِنْدَنَا خَزَا࢜ىِٕنُهٗؗ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهٗٓ اِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُوْمٍ
ayahs.translation: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known [i.e., specified] measure.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'im min shay'in illaa 'indanaa khazaa'inuhoo wamaa nunazziluhoo illaa biqadarim ma'loom
ayahs.translationClear: There is not a thing but with Us are its stores, and We send it down only in precise measure.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَـٰزِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَـٰزِنِينَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَرْسَلْنَا الرِّيٰحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَاَنْزَلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ مَا࢜ءً فَاَسْقَيْنٰكُمُوْهُۚ وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْتُمْ لَهٗ بِخٰزِنِيْنَ

words.translation: and We gave it to you to drink

ayahs.translation: And We have sent the fertilizing winds[673] and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'arsalnar-riyaaha lawaaqiha fa'anzalnaa minas-samaa'i maa'an fa'asqaynaakumoohu wamaa antum lahoo bikhaazineen

footnotes.673: Causing precipitation in rainclouds or carrying pollen. Another meaning is "pregnant winds," i.e., those carrying rainclouds.

ayahs.translationClear: We send the fertilizing winds; and send down water from the sky, and give it to you to drink, and you are not the ones who store it.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْيٖ وَنُمِيْتُ وَنَحْنُ الْوٰرِثُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.[674]

footnotes.674: Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) remains after all creation has passed away.

ayahs.translationClear: It is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritors.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَقْدِمِيْنَ مِنْكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا الْمُسْتَاْخِرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
ayahs.translationClear: And We know those of you who go forward, and We know those who lag behind.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْؕ اِنَّهٗ حَكِيْمٌ عَلِيْمٌ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'inna rabbaka huwa yahshuruhum innahoo hakeemun 'aleem
ayahs.translationClear: It is your Lord who will gather them together. He is the Wise, the Knowing.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَاٍ مَّسْنُوْنٍ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad khalaqnal-insaana min salsaalim min hama'im masnoon
ayahs.translationClear: We created the human being from clay, from molded mud.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَالْجَا࢜نَّ خَلَقْنٰهُ مِنْ قَبْلُ مِنْ نَّارِ السَّمُوْمِ
ayahs.translation: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
ayahs.transliteration: Wal-jaanna khalaqnaahu min qablu min naaris-samoom
ayahs.translationClear: And the jinn We created before, from piercing fire.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةِ اِنِّيْ خَالِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَاٍ مَّسْنُوْنٍ
ayahs.translation: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'idh qaala rabbuka lilmalaa'ikati innee khaaliqum basharam min salsaalim min hama'im masnoon
ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord said to the angels, “I am creating a human being from clay, from molded mud.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاِذَا سَوَّيْتُهٗ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيْهِ مِنْ رُّوْحِيْ فَقَعُوْا لَهٗ سٰجِدِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul,[675] then fall down to him in prostration."
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'idhaa sawwaytuhoo wanafakhtu feehi mir roohee faqa'oo lahoo saajideen

footnotes.675: The element of life and soul which Allāh created for that body, not His own spirit or part of Himself (as some mistakenly believe).

ayahs.translationClear: “When I have formed him, and breathed into him of My spirit, fall down prostrating before him.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَسَجَدَ الْمَلٰ࢜ىِٕكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ اَجْمَعُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
ayahs.translationClear: So the angels prostrated themselves, all together.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا͏ٓ اِبْلِيْسَؕ اَبٰٓي اَنْ يَّكُوْنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Except Iblees;[676] he refused to be with those who prostrated.
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa ibleesa abaa an yakoona ma'as-saajideen

footnotes.676: Who was of the jinn. See 18:50.

ayahs.translationClear: Except for Satan. He refused to be among those who prostrated themselves.

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ يٰٓاِبْلِيْسُ مَا لَكَ اَلَّا تَكُوْنَ مَعَ السّٰجِدِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala yaa'ibleesu maa laka allaa takoona ma'as-saajideen
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “O Satan, what kept you from being among those who prostrated themselves?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ لَمْ اَكُنْ لِّاَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهٗ مِنْ صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَاٍ مَّسْنُوْنٍ
ayahs.translation: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala lam akul li'asjuda libasharin khalaqtahoo min salsaalim min hama'im masnoon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “I am not about to prostrate myself before a human being, whom You created from clay, from molded mud.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَاِنَّكَ رَجِيْمٌ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "Then depart from it,[677] for indeed, you are expelled.
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Then get out of here, for you are an outcast.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَّاِنَّ عَلَيْكَ اللَّعْنَةَ اِلٰي يَوْمِ الدِّيْنِ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."
ayahs.translationClear: “And the curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ رَبِّ فَاَنْظِرْنِيْٓ اِلٰي يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala rabbi fa'anzirnee ilaa yawmi yub'athoon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “My Lord, reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ فَاِنَّكَ مِنَ الْمُنْظَرِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “You are of those reprieved.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلٰي يَوْمِ الْوَقْتِ الْمَعْلُوْمِ
ayahs.translation: Until the Day of the time well-known."
ayahs.translationClear: “Until the Day of the time appointed.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَا͏ٓ اَغْوَيْتَنِيْ لَاُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِي الْاَرْضِ وَلَاُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala rabbi bimaa aghwaytanee la'uzayyinanna lahum fil-ardi wala'ughwiyannahum ajma'een
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “My Lord, since You have lured me away, I will glamorize for them on earth, and I will lure them all away.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ الْمُخْلَصِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
ayahs.translationClear: “Except for Your sincere servants among them.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيْمٌ
ayahs.translation: [Allāh] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “This is a right way with Me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ عِبَادِيْ لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطٰنٌ اِلَّا مَنِ اتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ الْغٰوِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna 'ibaadee laysa laka 'alayhim sultaanun illaa manittaba'aka minal-ghaaween
ayahs.translationClear: “Over My servants you have no authority, except for the sinners who follow you.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ࣞۙ

words.translation: (is) surely the promised place for them

ayahs.translation: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
ayahs.translationClear: And Hell is the meeting-place for them all.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ اَبْوَابٍؕ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُوْمٌ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them [i.e., Satan's followers] a portion designated."
ayahs.transliteration: Lahaa sab'atu abwaabil likulli baabim minhum juz'um maqsoom
ayahs.translationClear: It has seven doors; for each door is an assigned class.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ فِيْ جَنّٰتٍ وَّعُيُوْنٍ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs,
ayahs.translationClear: But the righteous will be in gardens with springs.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اُدْخُلُوْهَا بِسَلٰمٍ اٰمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
ayahs.translationClear: “Enter it in peace and security.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِيْ صُدُوْرِهِمْ مِّنْ غِلٍّ اِخْوَانًا عَلٰي سُرُرٍ مُّتَقٰبِلِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment,[678] [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
ayahs.transliteration: Wanaza'naa maa fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwaanan 'alaa sururim mutaqaabileen
ayahs.translationClear: And We will remove all ill-feelings from their hearts—brothers and sisters, on couches facing one another.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيْهَا نَصَبٌ وَّمَا هُمْ مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.
ayahs.transliteration: Laa yamassuhum feehaa nasabun wamaa hum minhaa bimukhrajeen
ayahs.translationClear: No fatigue will ever touch them therein, nor will they be asked to leave it.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: نَبِّي͏ٔ͏ْ عِبَادِيْٓ اَنِّيْٓ اَنَا الْغَفُوْرُ الرَّحِيْمُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [O Muḥammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
ayahs.translationClear: Inform My servants that I am the Forgiver, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَنَّ عَذَابِيْ هُوَ الْعَذَابُ الْاَلِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.
ayahs.translationClear: And that My punishment is the painful punishment.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَنَبِّي͏ٔ͏ْهُمْ عَنْ ضَيْفِ اِبْرٰهِيْمَ ۘ
ayahs.translation: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
ayahs.translationClear: And inform them of the guests of Abraham.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: اِذْ دَخَلُوْا عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوْا سَلٰمًاؕ قَالَ اِنَّا مِنْكُمْ وَجِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful [i.e., apprehensive] of you."
ayahs.transliteration: Idh dakhaloo 'alayhi faqaaloo salaaman qaala innaa minkum wajiloon
ayahs.translationClear: When they entered upon him, and said, “Peace.” He said, “We are wary of you.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ ۝٥٣
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا لَا تَوْجَلْ اِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلٰمٍ عَلِيْمٍ
ayahs.translation: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo laa tawjal innaa nubashshiruka bighulaamin 'aleem
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Do not fear; we bring you good news of a boy endowed with knowledge.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ ۝٥٤
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ اَبَشَّرْتُمُوْنِيْ عَلٰٓي اَنْ مَّسَّنِيَ الْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُوْنَ

words.translation: Do you give me glad tidings
Do you give me glad tidings

ayahs.translation: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala abashshartumoonee 'alaa am massaniyal-kibaru fabima tubashshiroon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “Do you bring me good news, when old age has overtaken me? What good news do you bring?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِطِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِطِينَ ۝٥٥
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا بَشَّرْنٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُنْ مِّنَ الْقٰنِطِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo bashsharnaaka bil-haqqi falaa takum minal-qaaniteen
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “We bring you good news in truth, so do not despair.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ۝٥٦
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ وَمَنْ يَّقْنَطُ مِنْ رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهٖٓ اِلَّا الضَّا࢜لُّوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala waman yaqnatu mir rahmati rabbihee illad-daalloon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “And who despairs of his Lord’s mercy but the lost?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ ۝٥٧
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ اَيُّهَا الْمُرْسَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “So what is your business, O envoys?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ ۝٥٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْٓا اِنَّا͏ٓ اُرْسِلْنَا͏ٓ اِلٰي قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo innaa ursilnaa ilaa qawmim mujrimeen
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “We were sent to a sinful people.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝٥٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا͏ٓ اٰلَ لُوْطٍؕ اِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوْهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
ayahs.transliteration: Illaa aala lootin innaa lamunajjoohum ajma'een
ayahs.translationClear: “Except for the family of Lot; we will save them all.”

ayahs.textUthmani: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ‌ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ ۝٦٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اِلَّا امْرَاَتَهٗ قَدَّرْنَا͏ٓۙ اِنَّهَا لَمِنَ الْغٰبِرِيْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Except his wife." We [i.e., Allāh] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.[679]

footnotes.679: For having collaborated with the evildoers.

ayahs.translationClear: “Except for his wife.” We have determined that she will be of those who lag behind.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ ۝٦١
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَمَّا جَا࢜ءَ اٰلَ لُوْطِ اࣙلْمُرْسَلُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
ayahs.translationClear: And when the envoys came to the family of Lot.

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ ۝٦٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ اِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنْكَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “You are a people unknown to me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ ۝٦٣
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْا بَلْ جِي͏ٔ͏ْنٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوْا فِيْهِ يَمْتَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
ayahs.transliteration: Qaaloo bal ji'naaka bimaa kaanoo feehi yamtaroon
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “We bring you what they have doubts about.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَتَيْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَتَيْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ ۝٦٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَتَيْنٰكَ بِالْحَقِّ وَاِنَّا لَصٰدِقُوْنَ

words.translation: And we have come to you

ayahs.translation: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
ayahs.translationClear: “We bring you the truth, and we are truthful.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ ۝٦٥
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَسْرِ بِاَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ الَّيْلِ وَاتَّبِعْ اَدْبَارَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنْكُمْ اَحَدٌ وَّامْضُوْا حَيْثُ تُو͏ٔ͏ْمَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'asri bi'ahlika biqit'im minal-layli wattabi' adbaarahum walaa yaltafit minkum ahadun wamdoo haythu tu'maroon
ayahs.translationClear: “Travel with your family at the dead of the night, and follow up behind them, and let none of you look back, and proceed as commanded.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ ۝٦٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَضَيْنَا͏ٓ اِلَيْهِ ذٰلِكَ الْاَمْرَ اَنَّ دَابِرَ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ مَقْطُوْعٌ مُّصْبِحِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
ayahs.transliteration: Waqadaynaa ilayhi dhaalikal-amra anna daabira haa'ulaa'i maqtoo'um musbiheen
ayahs.translationClear: And We informed him of Our decree: the last remnant of these will be uprooted by early morning.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ ۝٦٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَا࢜ءَ اَهْلُ الْمَدِيْنَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And the people of the city came rejoicing.[680]

footnotes.680: At the news of Lot's visitors.

ayahs.translationClear: And the people of the town came joyfully.

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ ۝٦٨
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ اِنَّ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ ضَيْفِيْ فَلَا تَفْضَحُوْنِ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala inna haa'ulaa'i dayfee falaa tafdahoon
ayahs.translationClear: He said, “These are my guests, so do not embarrass me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ ۝٦٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاتَّقُوا اللّٰهَ وَلَا تُخْزُوْنِ
ayahs.translation: And fear Allāh and do not disgrace me."
ayahs.translationClear: “And fear Allah, and do not disgrace me.”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٧٠
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالُوْٓا اَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
ayahs.translationClear: They said, “Did we not forbid you from strangers?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قَالَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قَالَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ ۝٧١
ayahs.textIndopak: قَالَ هٰٓو͏ٔ͏ُلَا࢜ءِ بَنٰتِيْٓ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ فٰعِلِيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters[681] - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
ayahs.transliteration: Qaala haa'ulaa'i banaatee in kuntum faa'ileen

footnotes.681: i.e., the women of his community who were lawful for marriage.

ayahs.translationClear: He said, “These are my daughters, if you must.”

ayahs.textUthmani: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ ۝٧٢
ayahs.textIndopak: لَعَمْرُكَ اِنَّهُمْ لَفِيْ سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: By your life, [O Muḥammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
ayahs.translationClear: By your life, they were blundering in their drunkenness.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ ۝٧٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: So the shriek[682] seized them at sunrise.
ayahs.translationClear: So the Blast struck them at sunrise.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَجَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَجَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ ۝٧٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَاَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّنْ سِجِّيْلٍ ؕ
ayahs.translation: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
ayahs.transliteration: Faja'alnaa 'aaliyahaa saafilahaa wa'amtarnaa 'alayhim hijaaratam min sijjeel
ayahs.translationClear: And We turned it upside down, and rained down upon them stones of baked clay.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ ۝٧٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
ayahs.translationClear: Surely in that are lessons for those who read signs.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ ۝٧٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيْلٍ مُّقِيْمٍ
ayahs.translation: And indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.
ayahs.translationClear: And it is on an existing road.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝٧٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّلْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
ayahs.translationClear: Surely in that is a sign for the believers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَـٰلِمِينَ ۝٧٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنْ كَانَ اَصْحٰبُ الْاَيْكَةِ لَظٰلِمِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,
ayahs.translationClear: The people of the Woods were also wrongdoers.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ ۝٧٩
ayahs.textIndopak: فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْۘ وَاِنَّهُمَا لَبِاِمَامٍ مُّبِيْنٍ ؕࣖ
ayahs.translation: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
ayahs.translationClear: So We took revenge upon them. Both are clearly documented.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ ۝٨٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ اَصْحٰبُ الْحِجْرِ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And certainly did the companions of al-Ḥijr[683] [i.e., the Thamūd] deny the messengers.
ayahs.translationClear: The people of the Rock also rejected the messengers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ ۝٨١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاٰتَيْنٰهُمْ اٰيٰتِنَا فَكَانُوْا عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
ayahs.translationClear: We gave them Our revelations, but they turned away from them.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ ۝٨٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَكَانُوْا يَنْحِتُوْنَ مِنَ الْجِبَالِ بُيُوْتًا اٰمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
ayahs.translationClear: They used to carve homes in the mountains, feeling secure.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ ۝٨٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَخَذَتْهُمُ الصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: But the shriek seized them at early morning,
ayahs.translationClear: But the Blast struck them in the morning.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ ۝٨٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَمَا͏ٓ اَغْنٰي عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
ayahs.translationClear: All they had acquired was of no avail to them.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ‌ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ‌ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ ۝٨٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا͏ٓ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّؕ وَاِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لَاٰتِيَةٌ فَاصْفَحِ الصَّفْحَ الْجَمِيْلَ
ayahs.translation: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa khalaqnas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa illaa bil-haqqi wa'innas-saa'ata la'aatiyatun fasfahis-safhal-jameel
ayahs.translationClear: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and what lies between them, except with truth. The Hour is coming, so forgive with gracious forgiveness.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ۝٨٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ الْخَلّٰقُ الْعَلِيْمُ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord is the All-Knowing Creator.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ ۝٨٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ الْمَثَانِيْ وَالْقُرْاٰنَ الْعَظِيْمَ
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly given you, [O Muḥammad], seven of the often repeated [verses][684] and the great Qur’ān.
ayahs.translationClear: We have given you seven of the pairs, and the Grand Quran.

ayahs.textUthmani: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝٨٨
ayahs.textIndopak: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ اِلٰي مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهٖٓ اَزْوَاجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَاخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Laa tamuddanna 'aynayka ilaa maa matta'naa bihee azwaajam minhum walaa tahzan 'alayhim wakhfid janaahaka lilmu'mineen
ayahs.translationClear: Do not extend your eyes towards what We have bestowed on some couples of them to enjoy, and do not grieve over them, and lower your wing to the believers.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ ۝٨٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقُلْ اِنِّيْٓ اَنَا النَّذِيْرُ الْمُبِيْنُ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
ayahs.translationClear: And say, “I am the clear warner.”

ayahs.textUthmani: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ ۝٩٠
ayahs.textIndopak: كَمَا͏ٓ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَي الْمُقْتَسِمِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators[685]

footnotes.685: Those who separated from the teachings of their prophets. Another meaning is "As We sent down [punishment] on the sworn opponents [to Allāh's message]."

ayahs.translationClear: Just as We sent down to the separatists.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ ۝٩١
ayahs.textIndopak: الَّذِيْنَ جَعَلُوا الْقُرْاٰنَ عِضِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.[686]

footnotes.686: Accepting part and rejecting part according to their own inclinations.

ayahs.translationClear: Those who made the Quran obsolete.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝٩٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـٔ͏َلَنَّهُمْ اَجْمَعِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
ayahs.translationClear: By your Lord, We will question them all.

ayahs.textUthmani: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ۝٩٣
ayahs.textIndopak: عَمَّا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: About what they used to do.
ayahs.translationClear: About what they used to do.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ ۝٩٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاصْدَعْ بِمَا تُو͏ٔ͏ْمَرُ وَاَعْرِضْ عَنِ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then declare what you are commanded[687] and turn away from the polytheists.[688]

footnotes.687: The implication is "Thereby you will distinguish or separate the disbelievers from the believers."
footnotes.688: Any who persist in association of others with Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: So proclaim openly what you are commanded, and turn away from the polytheists.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ ۝٩٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّا كَفَيْنٰكَ الْمُسْتَهْزِءِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
ayahs.translationClear: We are enough for you against the mockers.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ‌ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٩٦
ayahs.textIndopak: الَّذِيْنَ يَجْعَلُوْنَ مَعَ اللّٰهِ اِلٰهًا اٰخَرَۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Who make [equal] with Allāh another deity. But they are going to know.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladheena yaj'aloona ma'allaahi ilaahan aakhara fasawfa ya'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: Those who set up another god with Allah. They will come to know.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۝٩٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ اَنَّكَ يَضِيْقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُوْلُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad na'lamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bimaa yaqooloon
ayahs.translationClear: We are aware that your heart is strained by what they say.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ ۝٩٨
ayahs.textIndopak: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُنْ مِّنَ السّٰجِدِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: So exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
ayahs.translationClear: So glorify the praise of your Lord, and be among those who bow down.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ ۝٩٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتّٰي يَاْتِيَكَ الْيَقِيْنُ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].
ayahs.translationClear: And worship your Lord in order to attain certainty.
